title: Live Agentic AI & Generative AI Application with Cloud (AWS & GCP)
_comment_overview: PARAPHRASED from the sponsor's page — never copy marketing prose verbatim into the repo. Facts (price, modules, format) are used as-is.
overview: A live, mentor-led bootcamp on building production agentic AI systems. Covers the LangChain/LangGraph stack, multi-agent design with CrewAI and AutoGen, agentic RAG, LLM observability, and deployment of generative AI workloads on AWS and GCP through end-to-end projects.

format._comment_cohort_start: NULL on purpose. The only cohort date the source publishes (2025-01-25) is in the past and lives in cohort_start_stale. Per schema §3 a past date must never sit in cohort_start — generate reads that field as a live persuasion fact. The consequence is deliberate and correct: freshness.py demotes a live/hybrid course with no future cohort to the `recorded` mode prior, because recordings of a finished cohort is operationally what a buyer gets today.

_comment_cohort: Listed start date (Jan 2025) is a PAST cohort. Stored for reference only, flagged stale — NEVER inject a stale date into recommendation copy. Field is excluded from the generate context.
_comment_objectives: SOURCE MISMATCH — see notes. The objectives block published alongside this course lists SpaCy / HuggingFace / text classification / NER / sentiment analysis, none of which appear in the 28-module syllabus. Those four are DROPPED. Only objectives corroborated by a real module are kept, because validate cites these to users.
objectives: Develop agentic systems using multi-agent collaboration, decision-making frameworks, and feedback loops
Master retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for grounding LLM outputs in retrieved information
Apply frameworks like LangChain and LangFlow to build scalable LLM workflows
Build and deploy conversational agents and chatbots with LangGraph, including third-party tool and API integration
Apply observability techniques for monitoring LLMs and agentic systems using Langfuse, LangWatch and LangSmith
Explore generative AI techniques including transformers and language models for text generation tasks
Deploy and fine-tune foundation models on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker) and GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini)
objectives_dropped: Text classification, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition
_comment_modules: 28 flat modules are grouped into 7 THEMATIC CLUSTERS. Do not emit 28 chunks: 3-word module titles embed poorly, and 28 vectors from one course would dominate RRF and starve the rest of the catalog.

modules: AWS cloud and services for generative AI
Fine-tuning foundation models on custom data
